content.text:
q20.

**Mechanism:** Server-Sent Events (SSE) over HTTP — a `GET /api/v1/sse` endpoint that emits `text/event-stream` with 30s heartbeat pings, Bearer-token authenticated. The browser consumes it with `EventSource` in `web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts`.

**Hub path:** `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` — `SSEHub` (mutex-guarded `map[*SSEClient]struct{}`, 32-event buffered per-client channel, drops events for slow clients). Constructed in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:57`, route registered at `v1.go:125` via `RegisterSSERoutes` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:25`, and closed on shutdown in `server/server.go:206`. Per-client visibility filtering lives in `SSEHub.Broadcast` / `SSEClient.canReceive` (`sse_hub.go:115`, `sse_hub.go:133`).

**Handlers that broadcast:**

| Handler | File:line | Event type |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:163` | `memo.created` (suppressed when called from `CreateMemoComment`) |
| `DeleteMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:585` | `memo.deleted` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:126` | `memo.comment.created` |
| `UpsertMemoReaction` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:106` | `reaction.upserted` |
| `DeleteMemoReaction` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:161` | `reaction.deleted` |
| `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations` | indirectly, via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:71` | `memo.updated` |

Those last three call the shared helper (`memo_service.go:513`, `memo_attachment_service.go:48`, `memo_relation_service.go:48`), which fires the updated-webhook and the SSE broadcast together.
